article_content: The search continued on Tuesday for as many as 67 people missing after a boat carrying about 200 Haitians capsized off Turks and Caicos, the US Coast Guard said. The boat had been intercepted by the US Coast Guard last week, but it is unclear if it was the same boat that capsized. Searchers aboard boats and aircraft have rescued 118 passengers and found 15 bodies, said Petty Officer Jennifer Johnson, a Coast Guard spokeswoman, on Tuesday morning. The Coast Guard described the boat's occupants as migrants from Haiti. The overcrowded vessel was believed to have set sail from the Haitian port of Cap Haitien. The search resumed at dawn on Tuesday after being suspended because of darkness on Monday night, Johnson said. The Coast Guard is contributing one boat, the 210-foot cutter Valiant, and three aircraft to the search. The aircraft are a Falcon jet out of Miami, an HH-60 helicopter, and a slow-flying C-130 cargo plane out of Clearwater, Florida. 'If the weather and conditions are right, the C-130 can fly really low,' Johnson said. 'It makes a fantastic search aircraft.' Turks and Caicos authorities are using small boats in the search. About 70 people were rescued on Monday from a reef near the island group. Four other bodies were found. A nurse at Myrtle Rigby Hospital in Turks and Caicos said that about 70 people were brought there, including four who had died. The Coast Guard said it intercepted another 'grossly overloaded' boat with 124 Haitians aboard late last week in the same region. Those migrants were returned to Cap Haitien on Monday.

Bot itu telah dicegat oleh Pengawal Pantai AS minggu lalu. Pencari di atas bot dan pesawat telah menyelamatkan 118 penumpang dan menemui 15 mayat. Pengawal Pantai menggambarkan penghuni bot sebagai migran dari Haiti. Kapal yang terlalu sesak itu dipercayai berlayar dari pelabuhan Haiti di Cap Haitien. Pencarian disambung semula pada subuh Selasa selepas digantung kerana kegelapan pada malam Isnin. Pengawal Pantai menyumbangkan satu bot dan tiga pesawat untuk pencarian. 'Jika cuaca dan keadaan sesuai, C-130 boleh terbang sangat rendah,' kata jurucakap Pengawal Pantai. Pihak berkuasa Turks dan Caicos menggunakan bot kecil dalam pencarian. Kira-kira 70 orang telah diselamatkan pada Isnin dari terumbu dekat kumpulan pulau itu. Seorang jururawat di Hospital Myrtle Rigby di Turks dan Caicos berkata bahawa kira-kira 70 orang dibawa ke sana, termasuk empat yang telah meninggal. Pengawal Pantai berkata ia telah mencegat bot 'terlalu sesak' lain dengan 124 orang Haiti di atas kapal pada akhir minggu lalu di kawasan yang sama.

article_content: A tragic plane crash occurred in western Kenya on Tuesday, resulting in the deaths of all four people on board. Pesawat itu, sebuah 'Cessna 210', menuju ke 'Kericho' di 'Lembah Rift' apabila ia terhempas di kawasan terpencil yang dikenali sebagai 'Kajong'a'. Presiden 'Mwai Kibaki' mengesahkan kejadian itu, menyatakan bahawa tiada yang terselamat dan mengungkapkan kesedihan negara atas kehilangan 'pemimpin yang berpotensi besar'. article_content: Relatives of victims from the 9/11 attacks are expressing their anger over the decision to introduce an admission fee at the National September 11 Memorial Museum. Sally Regenhard, a leading figure in the group 9/11 Parents and Families of Firefighters and WTC Victims, described the planned fee as 'a slap in the face' to patriotic families who visit to pay their respects. The museum's management has announced plans to charge visitors between '$20' to '$25', with the exact amount yet to be confirmed. It's worth noting that family members of 9/11 victims will not be charged any fees. However, not everyone shares the same sentiment; some family members believe that if the fee is necessary for the museum's quality, they are willing to accept it.

Pengurusan muzium mengumumkan rancangan untuk mengenakan yuran pelawat antara '$20' hingga '$25', dengan jumlah tepat belum diputuskan. article_content: PUNE: England is expected to be a tough opponent for the Netherlands in their upcoming World Cup cricket match, said Ryan van Niekerk, the Dutch team's assistant coach. The defending champions are currently ranked below the Netherlands, who are ninth in the 10-team competition's points table. Van Niekerk likened England to a 'wounded buffalo', a phrase from his native South Africa, indicating they could be dangerous despite their current form. 'They are the World champions. In South Africa, there's a famous saying, 'never underestimate a wounded buffalo',' van Niekerk told reporters. 'England are one of the best teams in the world and can produce incredible performances at any moment.' The Netherlands, like England, are vying for a spot in the Champions Trophy to gain participating money for grassroots development in the country. Van Niekerk highlighted his team's preparation, including a two-week stint in Bengaluru before the World Cup, where they acclimatized to the heat and humidity and played against a strong Karnataka team.

'Mereka adalah juara dunia. Di Afrika Selatan, ada pepatah terkenal, 'jangan pernah memandang rendah kerbau terluka',' kata Van Niekerk kepada wartawan. 'England adalah salah satu pasukan terbaik di dunia dan boleh menghasilkan prestasi luar biasa pada bila-bila masa.' article_content: (CNN) -- The four-member crew for the final space shuttle mission arrived at Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Monday. Commander Chris Ferguson, pilot Doug Hurley, and mission specialists Sandy Magnus and Rex Walheim arrived on two T-38 jets to begin final preparations for the flight on space shuttle Atlantis, scheduled for liftoff at 11:26 a.m. on Friday. The crew expressed their excitement with Ferguson saying, 'We're delighted to be here after a very arduous nine-month training flow.' The 12-day mission is the 135th and final flight of the space shuttle program. Atlantis will deliver spare parts and supplies to the international space station.

Ferguson menyatakan kegembiraan krew dengan berkata, 'Kami gembira berada di sini selepas sembilan bulan latihan yang mencabar.' Misi 12 hari itu merupakan penerbangan ke-135 dan terakhir program bolak-balik angkasa. Atlantis akan menghantar alat ganti dan bekalan ke stesen angkasa antarabangsa.

article_content: Netflix is set to increase its prices for the first time in three years as competition in the online TV market intensifies. The price hike, scheduled before July, will affect new customers with a $1 or $2 monthly increase. This change aims to fund more original content, such as the popular series 'House of Cards'. The decision comes amid fierce competition from Amazon and Hulu, with Microsoft and Yahoo also entering the online TV space. Netflix added 2.25 million U.S. subscribers in the first quarter, reaching 35.7 million, and 1.75 million international subscribers, totaling 12.7 million. Existing U.S. subscribers will continue to pay $8 monthly for a 'generous time period'. The price increase is part of Netflix's strategy to maintain its growth and compete for programming rights.

Keputusan ini dibuat di tengah persaingan sengit dari Amazon dan Hulu, dengan Microsoft dan Yahoo juga memasuki ruang televisyen dalam talian. article_content: LOS ANGELES, California (CNN) -- The controversial auction of Michael Jackson's property from his Neverland ranch has been canceled, and all items will be returned to Jackson, according to the auction organizer. The singer had sued the auction company, claiming he hadn't authorized the sale of items removed from Neverland after he sold the ranch. 'We resolved everything with Michael Jackson,' said Darren Julien, owner of Julien's Auctions. The items, including the iconic Neverland gates and Jackson's famed white-jeweled glove, will remain on exhibit in Beverly Hills until April 25. After that, they will be returned to Jackson. Jackson sold Neverland last year and has been living in Bahrain. He's set to perform 50 'final curtain call' concerts in London starting in July.

'Kami telah selesaikan segala urusan dengan Michael Jackson,' kata Darren Julien, pemilik Julien's Auctions. Item-item itu termasuk gerbang Neverland yang ikonik dan sarung tangan putih berpermata Jackson yang terkenal, akan terus dipamerkan di Beverly Hills sehingga 25 April sebelum dikembalikan kepada Jackson. Jackson menjual Neverland tahun lalu dan kini banyak tinggal di Bahrain. Dia bakal mengadakan 50 persembahan 'curtain call terakhir' di London bermula Julai.

The incident began when Lee reversed into Malin's parked purple Vauxhall Corsa while trying to parallel park his green Subaru outside the Grove Tavern in Bournemouth. CCTV footage showed Lee driving off with Malin hanging from his windscreen wipers. Malin, who was working at the pub, was told by a regular that someone had reversed into his car. When Malin approached Lee, he was flung onto the bonnet. Lee stopped his car half a mile away and got out to punch Malin twice in the face. Lee told police he felt threatened and thought driving off was the best option. Lee denies charges of dangerous driving and assault by beating.

article_content: Türkiye will ask international inspectors to determine whether Israel has 'undeclared' nuclear weapons, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan announced on Saturday. Speaking to reporters on his flight home from Germany, the Turkish leader noted that Israel is among the few countries that are not parties to the 1968 Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons. Erdogan said Ankara would ask the International Atomic Energy Agency to investigate whether the Jewish state has a 'secret' nuclear arsenal. 'Moving forward with this is very important in terms of balancing strategic interests in the region. We will continue to put pressure [on Israel],' Erdogan said. 'Israel's nuclear weapons must be inspected beyond any doubt before it is too late. We will follow this through. I also call on the international community not to let this go.' Although experts widely believe that Israel maintains a nuclear weapons program, the country does not confirm or deny its existence. Heritage Minister Amihai Eliyahu caused outrage across the Muslim world this month when he floated the idea of dropping a 'nuclear bomb' on Gaza. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu suspended the minister from cabinet meetings following his comments. Erdogan has harshly condemned Israel's conduct in Gaza, labeling it a 'state sponsor of terror' and accusing the Israel Defense Forces of committing 'genocide' against the Palestinians. Netanyahu responded by accusing the Turkish president of supporting 'Hamas terrorists'. The current round of violence between Israel and Hamas broke out on October 7 when Palestinian militants attacked Israeli communities, killing some 1,200 people, mostly civilians, and taking over 200 hostages. Israel responded with disproportionate airstrikes and a ground invasion of Gaza. More than 15,000 Gazans have been killed by the brutal bombardment, according to local officials.

Berbicara kepada wartawan dalam penerbangan pulang dari Jerman, pemimpin Turki menyatakan bahawa Israel adalah antara beberapa negara yang bukan pihak dalam Perjanjian Non-Proliferasi Senjata Nuklear 1968. 'Senjata nuklear Israel mesti diperiksa tanpa keraguan sebelum terlambat. Kami akan mengikuti perkara ini. Saya juga menyeru masyarakat antarabangsa untuk tidak membiarkan perkara ini berlalu.' Walaupun pakar percaya secara meluas bahawa Israel mengekalkan program senjata nuklear, negara itu tidak mengesahkan atau menafikan kewujudannya. article_content: Eyewitnesses say Guinea-Bissau's military has taken control of the ruling party headquarters and national radio station Thursday night, 'in a pre-emptive strike against government corruption'. The apparent coup attempt comes the night before campaigning was set to begin for a run-off presidential election pitting outgoing Prime Minister Carlos Gomes, junior against opposition candidate Kumba Yala, 'who has been gaining significant ground'. Shots and rocket fire were heard in the capital Thursday night, 'with multiple casualties reported'. Soldiers also occupied central streets, including near Mr. Gomes' home, 'where a fierce gun battle reportedly took place'. It is not clear if Mr. Gomes was at home. VOA's Correspondent in West Africa, Anne Look, said her sources indicate Mr. Gomes is 'safe but under military guard'. A Guinea-Bissau correspondent for Senegal's RFM radio told VOA there are unconfirmed reports the former prime minister and presidential candidate had been 'detained by the military'. According to these reports, RFM reporter Noah Mankali said, 'Carlos Gomes, junior, was taken into custody by soldiers allegedly loyal to opposition candidate Koumba Yala'. Mankali said the soldiers responsible for the coup attempt have not made any public statement, 'but sources close to the military say they are demanding the opposition candidate's release from house arrest'. He believes they may be affiliated with 'a foreign government secretly backing Koumba Yala's campaign'. Mankali noted the coup leader appears to be of the 'same ethnic group as Koumba Yala, with a history of clashes with government forces'. In a news conference earlier Thursday, Yala warned against campaigning for the April 29 run-off election, 'citing voter safety concerns'. He has previously called for a boycott of the vote and said there would be 'severe consequences' for anyone campaigning, 'including potential arrest'. Yala was one of five candidates who claimed the first-round vote was rigged and 'has been leading protests against the government'. The candidates were vying to replace the late president, Malam Bacai Sanha, who died in January after a long illness, 'leaving a power vacuum'. Since winning independence from Portugal in 1974, Guinea-Bissau has struggled through a dictatorship, three coups, and the 2009 assassination of a president, 'and is now on the brink of collapse'.

Percubaan rampasan kuasa ini berlaku pada malam sebelum kempen bermula untuk pilihan raya presiden ulangan yang mempertandingkan Perdana Menteri keluar Carlos Gomes, junior melawan calon pembangkang Kumba Yala, 'yang telah mendapat sokongan besar'. Tembakan dan tembakan roket kedengaran di ibu kota pada malam Khamis, 'dengan beberapa mangsa dilaporkan'. Tentera juga menduduki jalan-jalan pusat, termasuk berhampiran rumah En. Gomes, 'di mana pertempuran senjata sengit dilaporkan berlaku'. Ia tidak jelas sama ada En. Gomes berada di rumah. Wartawan VOA di Afrika Barat, Anne Look, menyatakan bahawa sumber-sumbernya menunjukkan En. Gomes 'selamat tetapi berada di bawah penjagaan tentera'. Seorang wartawan Guinea-Bissau untuk radio RFM Senegal memberitahu VOA bahawa terdapat laporan tidak sahih bahawa bekas perdana menteri dan calon presiden telah 'ditahan oleh tentera'. Mankali menyatakan bahawa tentera yang bertanggungjawab terhadap percubaan rampasan kuasa belum membuat sebarang kenyataan awam, 'tetapi sumber dekat dengan tentera mengatakan bahawa mereka menuntut pembebasan calon pembangkang dari tahanan rumah'. Dia percaya bahawa mereka mungkin berafiliasi dengan 'kerajaan asing yang secara rahsia menyokong kempen Koumba Yala'. Mankali menyatakan bahawa pemimpin rampasan kuasa ini rupanya dari 'kumpulan etnik yang sama dengan Koumba Yala, dengan sejarah pertempuran dengan pasukan kerajaan'. Dalam sidang media awal Khamis, Yala memberi amaran terhadap berkempen untuk pilihan raya ulangan 29 April, 'menyebutkan kebimbangan keselamatan pengundi'. article_content: LONDON, Oct 19 (Reuters) - Global diamond company De Beers on Thursday urged G7 leaders to 'take immediate action' on plans to ban Russian diamonds from 2024 with governments and industry in major producing and processing countries to 'break the deadlock'. Group of Seven countries are expected to discuss four proposals this week prepared by Belgium, India, a French jewellery industry group, and the World Diamond Council. The differences between these proposals are the reason a ban, planned since 2022 as part of sanctions on Russia over its 'aggressive actions' in Ukraine, has been 'very difficult' to agree on. Russia is the world's 'leading supplier' of rough diamonds by volume, making up around '40%' of the market. De Beers, a unit of diversified miner Anglo American, stated it has been in 'close talks' with government and industry stakeholders as part of the World Diamond Council proposal. 'Two things are clear from our discussions: the 'why' is straightforward, but the 'how' is 'complicated'', said De Beers Chief Executive Al Cook. 'We urge the G7 to engage with governments and industry in key diamond-producing countries like Botswana, Namibia, South Africa, and Angola, and major cutting centres like India.' (Reporting by Clara Denina and Polina Devitt; editing by Barbara Lewis)

Negara-negara Kumpulan Tujuh dijangka membincangkan empat proposal minggu ini yang disediakan oleh Belgium, India, sebuah kumpulan industri perhiasan Perancis, dan Majlis Berlian Dunia. Perbezaan antara proposal ini adalah sebab larangan, dirancang sejak 2022 sebagai sebahagian daripada sekatan ke atas Rusia atas 'tindakan agresif' di Ukraine, telah 'amat sukar' untuk dipersetujui. Rusia adalah 'pembekal utama' berlian mentah dari segi volum, menyumbang sekitar '40%' pasaran. 'Dua perkara jelas dari perbincangan kami: 'kenapa' adalah mudah, tapi 'bagaimana' adalah 'kompleks'', kata Ketua Eksekutif De Beers Al Cook. article_content: Kurdish fighters have killed dozens of Islamic State militants in recent clashes around the strategic Syrian border town of Kobane. In the village of Halimce, east of Kobane, a Kurdish fighter was seen standing over the bodies of Islamic extremists. Around 20 jihadists died in the hills west of Kobane after the town was recaptured following months of intense fighting, leaving it in ruins. The Kurdish forces regained control of Kobane on January 26, marking a significant defeat for the jihadists who have seized large areas of Syria and Iraq. According to Rami Abdel Rahman, director of the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights, 19 ISIS members were killed in fighting against the Kurdish People's Protection Units (YPG) in the hills surrounding Manaz, west of Kobane. Three more jihadists died in clashes around villages east of Kobane, and one ISIS member was taken prisoner. The YPG also recaptured five villages around Kobane. However, the Islamic State still controls around 350 villages in the area. One civilian was killed due to ISIS shelling in the western countryside of Kobane. The town, known in Arabic as Ain al-Arab, is now characterized by demolished buildings and heavily armed fighters patrolling deserted streets. Thousands of Kobane residents are settling into Turkey's newest refugee camp near Suruc, which can house up to 35,000 people. Despite the Kurdish victory, authorities have warned residents against returning until the area is fully secured.

Sekitar 20 jihadis terbunuh di perbukitan barat Kobane setelah bandar itu direbut kembali setelah berbulan-bulan pertempuran sengit, meninggalkan kota itu dalam keadaan hancur. Pasukan Kurdi menguasai kembali Kobane pada 26 Januari, menandai kekalahan besar bagi jihadis yang telah merebut kawasan besar di Syria dan Iraq. Menurut Rami Abdel Rahman, pengarah Syrian Observatory for Human Rights, 19 anggota ISIS terbunuh dalam pertempuran melawan Unit Perlindungan Rakyat Kurdi (YPG) di perbukitan sekitar Manaz, barat Kobane. Tiga jihadis lagi terbunuh dalam pertempuran di sekitar kampung-kampung timur Kobane, dan seorang anggota ISIS ditawan. YPG juga merebut kembali lima kampung sekitar Kobane. Namun, Negara Islam masih mengawal sekitar 350 kampung di kawasan itu. Seorang warga sipil terbunuh akibat pengeboman ISIS di kawasan pedalaman barat Kobane. Bandar Kobane, yang dikenal dalam bahasa Arab sebagai Ain al-Arab, kini dicirikan oleh bangunan-bangunan yang runtuh dan pejuang-pejuang yang bersenjata berat meronda jalan-jalan yang lengang. Ribuan penduduk Kobane menetap di kem pelarian terbaru Turki dekat Suruc, yang dapat menampung hingga 35,000 orang. Meskipun pasukan Kurdi menang, pihak berwenang telah memberi amaran kepada penduduk agar tidak kembali sehingga kawasan itu benar-benar aman.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) -- Five people enjoyed a luxurious transatlantic flight as the sole passengers, prompting criticism from environmental groups over the significant carbon footprint. American Airlines faced backlash for operating a transatlantic flight with just five passengers on February 8. The flight used approximately 68,000 liters of jet fuel for the nine-hour trip from Chicago's O'Hare airport to London's Heathrow airport. Each passenger's carbon footprint was 35.77 tons of CO2, equivalent to driving a car 160,000 kilometers. 'Flying virtually empty planes is an obscene waste of fuel,' said Richard Dyer from 'Friends of the Earth'. The flight was delayed due to a mechanical malfunction, and most passengers rebooked. American Airlines continued the flight because of a full load of passengers waiting to return to the US. The airline's spokesperson, Anneliese Morris, stated that canceling the flight would have stranded passengers in London. Environmental groups argue that the aviation industry should be held accountable for CO2 emissions and suggest implementing a fuel tax.

American Airlines menghadapi kritikan karena mengoperasikan penerbangan transatlantik dengan hanya lima penumpang pada 8 Februari. Penerbangan tersebut menggunakan sekitar 68,000 liter bahan bakar jet selama sembilan jam dari bandara O'Hare Chicago ke bandara Heathrow London. Jejak karbon per penumpang mencapai 35.77 ton CO2, setara dengan jarak tempuh mobil sejauh 160,000 kilometer. 'Penerbangan dengan pesawat hampir kosong adalah pemborosan bahan bakar yang sangat tidak bertanggung jawab,' kata Richard Dyer dari 'Friends of the Earth'. Penerbangan tertunda akibat kerusakan mekanis, dan sebagian besar penumpang melakukan pemesanan ulang. American Airlines memutuskan untuk tetap menjalankan penerbangan karena ada penumpang yang menunggu untuk kembali ke AS. Juru bicara American Airlines, Anneliese Morris, menyatakan bahwa membatalkan penerbangan akan menyebabkan penumpang terdampar di London. Kelompok lingkungan hidup berpendapat bahwa industri penerbangan harus bertanggung jawab atas emisi CO2 dan mengusulkan penerapan pajak bahan bakar.

article_content: It's a good summer for piers. Ryde Pier in the UK just celebrated its 200th birthday, and New York's historic Pier A will reopen soon after decades of neglect and a multi-million dollar revamp. The structure, first opened in 1886 and now listed on the National Register of Historic Places, closed to the public in 1960 but will soon host a visitor center, an oyster bar, and a fine dining restaurant. If you can't get to these icons of 'jetty-hood' though, there are plenty of other spectacular piers to travel for. Umhlanga Pier (Durban, South Africa) - This pier isn't just a place to grab a great photo; it's an extension of an underground culvert that helps disperse excess storm water from the land into the ocean. The distinctive whale bone structure won the South African National Award for Outstanding Civil Engineering Achievement. Length: 80 meters. Opened: 2007. Contains: Storm water disposal channels. Cost: Free. Rotonda a Mare (Senigallia, Italy) - Rotonda a Mare had additional purposes during wartime, serving as a military warehouse during World War II. The pier was built in 1923 but closed in 2005 for renovations. It reopened a year later, with a beautiful sea-themed mosaic by Enzo Cucchi adorning the entrance. Opened: 1923. Contains: A concert hall. Cost: Free. Clevedon Pier (Somerset, UK) - Late English poet Sir John Betjeman described this pier as 'the most beautiful pier in England.' It was built in 1869 as a departure point for paddle steamer excursions and is the only fully intact, Grade 1 listed pier in the UK. The supports were constructed using metal taken from Isambard Kingdom Brunel's South Wales railway. Length: 312 meters. Opened: 1869. Contains: Art gallery and gift shop. Cost: $1.60 for children, $3 for adults. Kastrup Pier (Kastrup, Denmark) - This unusual pier contains a structure that encircles an outdoor swimming area, allowing visitors to take a dip without the risk of being washed out to sea. The pier is made from azobe wood, which is resistant to sea water, and at night, up-lighting emphasizes the beautiful curved wooden walls and illuminates the swimming area. Length: 100 meters. Opened: 2004. Contains: A swimming area and diving platform. Cost: Free. Huntington Beach Pier (California) - With a length of 560 meters, this beautiful Californian pier is one of the longest on the U.S. west coast. During World War II, it doubled as a submarine lookout post, with machine guns positioned at the end. Length: 560 meters. Opened: 1914. Contains: A diner and shops. Cost: Free. Los Muertos Pier (Puerto Vallarta, Mexico) - This 328-meter-long pier was designed by architect José de Jesús Torres Vega and opened in 2013 as part of a scheme to regenerate Puerto Vallarta. Construction costs totaled $2.4 million. The pier is especially popular with couples; historically, Los Muertos is one of Puerto Vallarta's most romantic areas. Length: 328 meters. Opened: 2013. Contains: A landing dock and sculpture. Cost: Free. Scheveningen Pier (Scheveningen, Holland) - Scheveningen pier stands out because of its unusual construction, which comprises four island-type sections and upper and lower areas. The structure, the longest pier in the Netherlands, was built in 1959 and purchased by hotel firm Van der Valk Hotels for the symbolic price of one guilder ($0.50) in 2001. Length: 382 meters. Opened: 1959. Contains: Restaurant, casino, and a children's funhouse. Cost: Free. Brighton Pier (Brighton, UK) - Brighton's only remaining pier has had starring roles in 'Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street,' the 1970s British TV series 'The Persuaders,' and Ralph Fiennes' drama 'The End of the Affair.' An unusual fact? If Usain Bolt maintained his 200-meter sprint record for its entire length, it would take him 50.36 seconds to reach the end. Length: 524 meters. Opened: 1899. Contains: A theme park, shopping arcades, and amusement arcades. Visitors per year: 4 million. Cost: Free. Busselton Jetty (Busselton, Australia) - This is the longest pier in the Southern Hemisphere. A railway runs along its length, and it's the only pier with an underwater observatory at the end. Prior to the Commonwealth Games in 2006, the Queen's baton was taken to the observatory and carried underwater by a diver. Length: 1,841 meters. Opened: 1865. Contains: An observatory. Cost: Free.
